`new-fleet-base` is the integration base for the in-progress slice-fleet generation-2 program (specs/slice-fleet-gen2 and specs/slice-fleet): the squash of the formerly stacked PRs #571, #573, #574, #581, #609, and #614. It is deployed only to dev canaries and must not be deployed or merged as-is; follow-up PRs stack on it and the whole program lands on `main` as one change.

For the repo-level project it carries: the two specs (`specs/slice-fleet-gen2/spec.md`, historical, and `specs/slice-fleet/spec.md`, which supersedes it), the `blueprint/slice-fleet-variable-sizing/` plan with its canary handoff and `gen2-turnover-notes.md`, the guest-image divergence note in `uncertainties.md`, the committed credential-expiry registry (`.github/credential-expiries.toml`) with its weekly reminder workflow and `scripts/credential_expiry_reminder.py`, and the `OBSERVABILITY_ALERTS_GITHUB_TOKEN` addition to the observability Vault schema. The detailed per-phase history is in this directory's `mngr-design-network-observation`, `mngr-slice-fleet-gen2-phase-*`, `mngr-variable-sizing`, `mngr-new-fleet-testing`, `mngr-finish-new-fleet-canary-testing`, `mngr-slice-fleet-canary-followups`, and `mngr-onetun-install-and-canary` entries.

New `blueprint/slice-fleet-cutover/plan-slice-fleet-cutover.md`: the plan for finishing the program from this branch to a gen-2-only fleet landed on `main` -- hardening + runsc-native slices, deletion of the in-supervisor conversion and mixed-fleet machinery, a shared gen-2 renderer subpackage, the one-time `minds-admin cutover` tooling, the per-tier flag-day rollout, and the post-cutover deletion. It supersedes phases 3-6 of `specs/slice-fleet/spec.md`.

- Specs and CLEANUP comments follow the gen-2 migration renumbering (033-036 -> 034-037).
